Security Policy
===============

If you found something which shouldn't be there or a bug which opens a security hole, please report it privately via GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting: open the **Security** tab of the repository and click **Report a vulnerability** (https://github.com/roxblnfk/unpoly/security/advisories/new).

The report is visible only to the maintainer until an advisory is published.

DO NOT PUBLISH SECURITY REPORTS PUBLICLY (e.g. in issues or pull requests).
